title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_non_dirlo_a_nessuno_by_k_a_linde_pf1lp (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_non_dirlo_a_nessuno_by_k_a_linde_pf1lp' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a separate, trusted device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
